{"id":1860046156,"question_id":4146,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months","timestamp":1766169788,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"63 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1860046156/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Total Score of Dungeon Runs","memory":"249.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int binarysearch(int j, int target, vector<int>&pref){\n        int start = 0;\n        int end = j;\n        int ans = -1;\n        while(start <= end)\n        {\n            int mid = start + (end-start) / 2;\n            if(target >= -pref[mid])\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                end = mid - 1;\n            }\n            else start = mid + 1;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n    \n    long long totalScore(int hp, vector<int>& damage, vector<int>& requirement) {\n        vector<int> pref(damage.size()+1,0);\n\n        pref[0] = 0;\n        pref[1] = damage[0];\n\n        for(int i=2; i<=damage.size(); i++)\n        {\n            pref[i] = pref[i-1] + damage[i-1];\n        }\n\n        long long ans = 0;\n        for(int j = 0; j < requirement.size(); j++)\n        {\n            long long target = hp - pref[j+1] - requirement[j];\n            int valid_idx = binarysearch(j,target,pref);\n            ans += (valid_idx == -1) ? 0 : j-valid_idx+1;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"total-score-of-dungeon-runs","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1355}
